chunks: “No one harbors hatred toward us except one whose birth was impure or whose mother conceived him while she was menstruating.”
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about those who hate the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes hatred for the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام to a deeply corrupt origin and condition. It underscores the exalted status of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and presents love for them as a sign of sound disposition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.203 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
'No one harbors hatred toward us except one whose birth was impure or whose mother conceived him while She was menstruating.'
